data.title: New OpenSSF Tech Talk: How Upstream Contribution Minimizes Technical Debt & Streamlines CRA Reporting
data.summary: Maintaining private forks of open source software (OSS) comes with a hidden tax, costing organizations an average of 5,160 labor hours per release cycle in maintenance and engineering overhead. Beyond the accumulating technical debt and security risks, passive open source consumption is no longer sustainable under emerging regulatory frameworks like the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), which imposes strict security and vulnerability management mandates.

data.title: Who Checked It? Attestations, Gemara, and CRA Due Diligence
data.summary: Discover how the OpenSSF Gemara project clarifies the complex world of security attestations, streamlines software supply chain evaluations, and helps organizations confidently meet EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) due diligence requirements.

data.title: New OpenSSF Guide: Finding and Fixing Vulnerabilities Using AI
data.summary: AI has gotten good at finding software vulnerabilities, and attackers are already using it. For example, “AI-enabled adversaries increased attacks by 89% year-over-year” according to the CrowdStrike 2026 Global Threat Report. If you maintain or develop software, it is critical to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them.

data.title: What’s in the SOSS? Podcast #76 – S3E28 Invisible Infrastructure, Autonomous Agents, and 10 Years of Cloud Native with CNCF’s Chris Aniszczyk
data.summary: In this episode of What's in the SOSS, host CRob sits down with CNCF CTO Chris Aniszczyk to celebrate a decade of scaling invisible infrastructure. They dive into the evolution of Kubernetes, the cultural friction within AI teams, and how initiatives like the Kubernetes AI Conformance Program are maintaining vendor neutrality.

data.title: Case Study: GitHub Expands Malware Advisories Across Eight Ecosystems with OpenSSF
data.summary: Learn how GitHub integrated OpenSSF's malicious-package data into its Advisory Database to expand Dependabot malware alerts across eight ecosystems.

data.title: Introducing Privateer: AI-Assisted Security & Compliance Evaluation Framework Joins the OpenSSF Sandbox
data.summary: Discover Privateer, a new plugin-based, AI-assisted security and compliance evaluation framework that has officially joined the OpenSSF Sandbox under the ORBIT Working Group.

data.title: What’s in the SOSS? Podcast #75 – S3E27 From Upstream to Downstream: Managing Open Source Risk in a Changing Regulatory Era with Vincent Danen
OpenSSF Shares Expanded Membership and New Global Policy Resources During Community Day Europe
data.summary: The OpenSSF announced expanded membership during its Community Day Europe, welcoming four new members: A-Team Systems, Emphere, DACHS IT GMBH, and JetBrains. The Foundation also released significant CRA resources to deepen Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) preparedness. These updates come as regulatory pressure grows and mandatory CRA reporting takes effect, driving the need for clear guidance and systemic collaboration on open source security.

data.title: What’s in the SOSS? Podcast #74 – S3E26 Building the Agentic Future with Angie Jones
data.summary: Discover the future of AI agents with Angie Jones, VP of Developer Experience at the Agentic AI Foundation. Learn about open source standards, MCP, and secure agentic engineering on the OpenSSF podcast.
